name: ESP32-S3 DevKitC-1
description: Espressif's ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 (ESP32-S3-WROOM-1, dual-core Xtensa LX7 at 240 MHz, Wi-Fi / BLE not emulated, 8 MB flash), 44 pins, two USB-C ports (USB-to-UART: Serial on UART0; native USB), BOOT and RESET buttons and an addressable RGB LED (GPIO48 on v1.0, GPIO38 on v1.1; not drawn: RMT is not emulated). Runs real arduino-esp32 firmware in Espressif's QEMU on your computer (Docker). Pin ids are GPIO numbers. 3.3 V logic only.

bindings.description: Board has power: USB plugged (power.usb) or a supply wired to its power pins keeps the 3.3 V rail up; the firmware is held in reset while false.
True when this board runs the project's firmware (has an MCU backend).
Digital level 0/1 of each GPIO, e.g. pin_GPIO2 (only on the firmware board).

strapping.note: GPIO0 LOW at reset starts the ROM downloader instead of your program (the BOOT button).
GPIO3 selects the JTAG source only when the eFuse asks for it.
GPIO45 HIGH at reset selects 1.8 V flash: the WROOM-1 then does not boot. Do not pull it up.
GPIO46 must be LOW or floating at reset (with GPIO0 it picks the boot mode).
